parsed.why: Strong traveller-facing framework: anti-discrimination, hate-crime aggravators, marriage, no border or facility restrictions; documented anti-trans violence and institutional bias partly offset by prosecutions, police human-rights unit and trans-inclusive prison protocol. 2024 regression a mild drag.

Documents must show birth sex, so an outed visitor faces ID mismatch; no gender-identity anti-discrimination or hate-crime law, government tolerance of bias crimes, current official hostility, birth-sex custody. Violence record dated, but state stance and document exposure dominate.

Constitutional and statutory gender-identity protections, hate-crime aggravators, favourable marker-change ruling, visible Pride; no criminalisation or border friction. But enforcement inconsistent, political hate speech common, and no remedy shown working for visitors.

Hostile state architecture on gender markers and official demonisation, but that is largely resident-facing; no documented border, facility or police exposure for visitors, and functioning rule of law plus the 2026 court ruling and change of government mitigate. Climate drag only.

Paper protections (anti-discrimination, hate-crime aggravators) not shown operating: police use morals law to harass trans women, documented extortion and assault, impunity for killings, birth-sex custody. State-tolerated targeting outweighs the statutes.
